_comment: Single source of truth for a Harness KB. Every ENUMERABLE rule lives here; documents and gates DERIVE from this file instead of hand-copying values that drift apart. See docs/blueprint.md section 5 (H1). Replace the example vocabulary/areas with your own.

structure.note_folder_pattern: one folder per note, with an attachments/ subfolder

documents._comment: Documents that RESTATE the enumerable facts above. They keep the numbers for human readers, but each such line carries a marker comment (e.g. <!-- rules:tag_count -->) so check_rules_drift.py can compare it with this file instead of comparing hand-copied lists against each other.

index_count.description: Number of index files, counted from the filesystem

tag_list.description: This document enumerates the whole vocabulary; a missing tag is an error

scan_heuristics._comment: Noise control for the sweep over UNMARKED numbers. min_value: anything smaller is prose ('index files carry 1 tag only'), not a count. retired_mention_ok: a line that mentions a retired tag in order to say it was dropped is fine.
